description: Topic-wise Performance Heatmap on /insights and Smart Review Queue on Dashboard. (1) Adds a visual heatmap to the Insights page showing per-topic accuracy across all 10 CFA subjects with color-coded cells (red/yellow/green/gray). Clicking a cell starts a filtered practice session. (2) Adds a Smart Review Queue accessible from Dashboard that combines due flashcards + due practice questions + due revision subjects into one unified queue with estimated time and a celebration screen on completion.
steps: Create src/features/insights/components/topic-heatmap.tsx: Client component showing a grid/table. 10 rows (one per CFA subject in curriculum order from sortByCfaOrder). Columns = unique readings/topics derived from questions in that subject (using loadAllQuestions from question-loader.ts). Cell color based on accuracy: red (#ef4444, 0-40%), yellow (#C5A258, 40-70%), green (#00843D, 70-100%), gray (var(--nav-hover-bg), not attempted). On hover: tooltip showing 'Subject > Topic: X% (Y/Z correct)'. On click: navigate to /practice?subject=X&topic=Y (practice mode filtered). Use CSS grid. Mobile: horizontal scroll with sticky first column.
Modify src/features/insights/components/insights-content.tsx: Import and render TopicHeatmap below the existing charts. Add a section header 'Topic Performance Heatmap'.
Create src/features/review-queue/ directory with types/, utils/, components/ subdirs

Create src/features/review-queue/types/index.ts: ReviewItem { id: string, type: 'flashcard' | 'question' | 'revision', title: string, subject: string, data: any }. ReviewQueueState { items: ReviewItem[], currentIndex: number, completed: boolean, startedAt: string | null }.

Create src/features/review-queue/utils/queue-builder.ts: Function buildReviewQueue() that gathers: (1) Due flashcards from getCardsDueToday (flashcards/utils/sm2.ts + flashcards/utils/storage.ts), (2) Due practice questions from practice-storage (questions with nextDue <= now), (3) Subjects due for revision (from cfa-buddy-revision-schedule localStorage where nextRevisionDate <= today). Returns unified ReviewItem[] array ordered: flashcards first, then questions, then revision prompts. Also compute estimatedMinutes (1 min per flashcard, 2 min per question, 5 min per revision topic).

Create src/features/review-queue/components/review-queue-content.tsx: Main client component. States: queue items, current index, in-progress. Shows summary: 'You have X items to review today (~Y minutes)'. 'Start Review' button begins the flow. Renders appropriate UI based on item type: flashcard (show front, flip to back, rate), question (show question, reveal answer, rate using practice algorithm), revision (show subject name + prompt to review, mark done button). After all items complete: show celebration screen with stats (items completed, time taken, accuracy for questions). Store completion state so it doesn't re-show until next day.
Create src/features/review-queue/components/review-celebration.tsx: Celebration screen with large checkmark, confetti (reuse from gamification), stats summary, and 'Back to Dashboard' button.

Add a 'Smart Review' card on Dashboard: In src/features/dashboard/components/dashboard-content.tsx, add a prominent card above Quick Actions showing due review count (from queue-builder) + 'Start Review' button that navigates to /review. Format: 'You have X items to review today | ~Y minutes | Start Review [button]'.
Create src/app/(protected)/review/page.tsx: Server component rendering ReviewQueueContent.
Add 'Review' to navigation in src/shared/config/navigation.ts: { name: 'Review', href: '/review', icon: ListChecks } (import ListChecks from lucide-react). Place after 'Practice' in the list.
acceptance_criteria: Heatmap renders on /insights with color-coded cells per topic per subject
Hovering a heatmap cell shows tooltip with accuracy details
Clicking a heatmap cell navigates to /practice with topic filter
/review page shows unified queue of due flashcards + questions + revision subjects
Review flow handles all 3 item types with appropriate UI
Estimated time shows based on item count
Celebration screen appears after completing all items
Dashboard shows smart review card with due item count
Review navigation item appears in sidebar
findings: All verification passed: 0 TS errors, lint clean, build succeeds (review route generated as static), 85 tests pass. React purity rule required using useState lazy initializer for startTime instead of useRef(Date.now()) or Date.now() in render body. performance.now() used in event handlers for time calculation. The review queue uses performance.now for session timing to avoid Date.now purity errors.
